listing.name: Terraforming Made Easy
listing.summary: A mod that adds new structures that can terraform planets, change the visuals of a planet, and construct megastructures like orbital stations. Adds an option to build domain satellites like nav buoys on stable points.
listing.aiSummary: Adds structures to terraform planets, change their visuals, and construct megastructures like orbital stations.

description:
Terraforming Made Easy 2.10.6

Compatibility:
Safe to add mid-game
Not compatible with saves on 2.9.8 and below
Not safe to remove mid-game
No known mod conflicts

Integrations:
LunaLib - Has native support for mod settings
AotD-VoK - Has native support for research system.
A mod that adds new structures that can terraform planets, change the visuals of a planet,
and construct megastructures like orbital stations. Adds an option to build domain satellites like nav buoys on stable points.

Previews
Click the image to enlarge

Structures
Agricultural Laboratory Thanks to the extensive agricultural research on Gilead and Eventide, advancing agricultural science tailored to each planet can be achieved within a reasonable timeframe. From enriching soil fertility to bioengineering robust crops, this facility enables the creation and improvement of farmland on habitable planets.
Can terraform farming conditions of a planet
Atmosphere Regulator Massive industrial vents and pumps are built near volcanoes and underground chemical deposits. These structures are then use to carefully pump or vent material in to the atmosphere causing it to change with time.
Can terraform atmospheric conditions of a planet
Construction Grid A massive orbital framework designed to serve as the foundation for large-scale engineering projects. Functioning as both scaffolding and logistical hub, it provides the structural stability, docking points, and assembly systems required for construction.
Can construct megastructures like orbital stations, gates, etc.
Element Synthesizer By studying plasma furnaces and quantum-catalytic reactions, this high-end research facility pioneers methods to refine common minerals into valuable rare ores and volatile compounds. The research enables colonies to manufacture synthetic deposits that function as though they were naturally occurring.
Can terraform rare mineral conditions of a planet
Geomorphology Station A planetary-scale installation capable of reshaping social and geological environments. Through methods such as irradiation, engineered plagues, induced flooding, or the introduction of invasive species, it can transform geology and biospheres to suit specific agendas. Colonies may use it to exploit resources or impose control over resistant populations.
Can terraform environmental and social conditions of a planet
Mineral Replicator By harnessing catalytic forges and molecular synthesis, this facility develops methods to replicate common ores and organic materials from trace compounds. The research enables colonies to produce synthetic deposits that function as if they were naturally occurring.
Can terraform common mineral conditions of a planet
Planetary Hologram Holographic emitters are launched into orbit around a planet, forming an interconnected net. These emitters can be calibrated to project a wide range of holographic visuals, from masking a volcanic world to appear as a lush, terran paradise to disguising a populated, habitable planet as a lifeless, barren rock.
Can change the visuals of a planet
Stellar Manufactory An industrial complex dedicated to manufacturing parts and materials for constructing small terraforming orbital structures. From weather stations to stellar shades and mirrors, these installations are used to manipulate a planet's temperature, weather, and lighting.
Can terraform weather, temperature and lighting conditions of a planet
Terrestrial Engine Built deep beneath the planet's surface is a network of graviton projectors and seismic regulators. These systems manipulate tectonic stresses and gravitational harmonics. By redistributing planetary mass and directing geologic energy, they can stabilize or trigger fault lines, or even alter gravitational force.
Can terraform tectonic and gravitational conditions of a planet
Unification Center A centralized government is created to unify the various polities on a colonized planet. Representatives from these polities can be directed to issue mandates to their respective populations to pursue specific goals or agendas, allowing a colony to specialize in different areas, from economic enrichment to military development.
Can issue mandates that specializes the planet for specific purposes

How to Use
1. Build a structure from this mod on a colony you own and wait for the structure to finish building
3. Right click the structure then select the terraforming option button
4. Select a planetary condition you want to add or remove then click the start button
6. Wait for the structure to finish terraforming and you are done

Terraforming Guide
1. Habitable planets appear when all -50% hazard conditions are removed.
- Habitable hot planets appear when a hot condition is added (Jungle, Arid, etc.).
- Habitable cold planets appear when a cold condition is added (Tundra, etc.).
- Habitable water-surface planets appear when a water-surface condition is added (Water Planet).
2. Lava planets appear when a Very Hot condition or Extreme Tectonic Activity condition is added.
3. Barren planets appear when a No Atmosphere condition is added (Cast Iron, Venus-Like, Bombarded, etc.).
- Rocky unstable planets appear when any Tectonic Activity condition is added.
- Rocky ice planets appear when a Cold condition is added.
4. Frozen planets appear when a Very Cold condition is added.
5. Toxic planets appear when a Toxic condition is added.
6. Irradiated planets appear when an Irradiated condition is added.
7. Cryovolcanic planets appear when both a Very Cold condition and any Tectonic Activity condition are present.
8. Ice giants appear when any Cold condition is added to a gas giant.
9. Gas giants appear when any Hot condition is added to a gas giant, or when all temperature conditions are removed from one.

How the final planet type is determined
The rules are checked in order, starting with rule 1. Each rule is evaluated using the planet's current conditions after terraforming.

If a rule matches, its corresponding planet type is selected. However, the subsequent rules are also checked to see if any of them result in a different planet type. This continues until a rule fails, at which point the last successfully selected planet type becomes the final result.

For example, if a planet qualifies as Barren but also has the Toxic condition, it will become a Toxic planet. Similarly, if it qualifies as Barren but no subsequent rule changes its type, it will remain Barren.

Settings
- Option to configure the cost multiplier for terraforming and megastructure projects:
- Low = 0.5x
- Normal = 1.0x
- High = 2.0x
- Custom = Set your own multiplier
- Option to set the cost mode multiplier of terraforming and megastructure projects
- Fast = 0.5x
- Normal = 1.0x
- Slow = 2.0x
- Custom = Set your own multiplier

- If you have lunalib, options are in the mod settings
- If you don't have lunalib, options are in the settings.json file located in "thismodname/data/config/..."

Advance
- You need a text editor to modify the files mentioned below
- I recommend ModernCSV, RonsDataEdit to edit csv files
- I recommend VSCode, Notepad++ to edit txt, json files
- Restart the game for any changes to the files mentioned below

- To modify or add terraforming projects, open terraforming_options.csv file in "thismodname/data/campaign/terraformingmadeeasy..."
- To modify or add megastructure projects open megastructure_options.csv file in "thismodname/data/campaign/terraformingmadeeasy..."

- Vanilla conditions are found in market_conditions.csv file in "starsector-core/data/campaign/..."
- Vanilla industries are found in industries.csv file in "starsector-core/data/campaign/..."
- Vanilla entities are found in custom_entities.json file in "starsector-core/data/config/..."

- Modded conditions are found in market_conditions.csv file in "mods/modname/data/campaign/..."
- Modded industries are found in industries.csv file in "mods/modname/data/campaign/..."
- Modded entities are found in custom_entities.json file in "mods/modname/data/config/..."

Need help or want to send feedback, you can make a post on this thread.
Want to support me? you can do so through my Patreon page.

Credits
Wispborne - for the starsector intellij mod template and the github action script.
Kentington - for the implementation of changing planet visuals in DIY planets.
starsector community - for many resources in regard to modding and spriting.
Alex and Co - for making a great game and community.

aiDescription: Allows players to build various facilities that modify planetary conditions such as atmosphere, minerals, and weather. It also enables the construction of megastructures and domain satellites, with options to configure project costs and speeds.

A screenshot of the Starsector map showing planets and a tooltip for 'Terraforming'.
